problem: exact quantum query complexity of n-element ordered search (Table 8 item 9)

record.source: Y. Wu, H. Liu, W. Gao, Y. Su, T. Li, D. Ge, Y. Ye, 'Matrix-Free GPU Semidefinite Programming for Quantum Ordered Search at the k=6 Frontier', ICML 2026 poster (icml.cc/virtual/2026/poster/65135; openreview GSGOyxRrBo)
record.note: 'strong numerical evidence' that N*(6) >= 90000 (not certified); rigorous dual certificate N*(6) < 94000

win_rule: certified (k, n) with n^6 > 90000^k (beats the best explicit finite claim, which is numerical); n^6 = 90000^k certifies it rigorously (MATCHES_RECORD); beats_prior_explicit: n^5 > 7265^k

lower_bound.statement: exact algorithms need >= (ln n - 1)/pi queries, about 0.2206 log2 n
lower_bound.source: Hoyer-Neerbek-Shi, quant-ph/0102078 (ICALP 2001; Algorithmica 34, 2002); Childs-Lee, arXiv:0708.3396 (2008): the adversary method cannot do better

theorem: FGGS99 / CLP07 / Thm 8 of arXiv:2503.21090: an exact k-query translation-invariant algorithm for n-element ordered search exists iff symmetric nonnegative Laurent polynomials q_0..q_k of degree < n exist with q_0 = Fejer kernel F_n, q_k = 1, constant terms 1 and q_t = q_(t-1) on z^n = (-1)^t; Thm 1 of arXiv:2503.21090: translation invariance is without loss of generality

prior_explicit.source: J. Carolan, A. M. Childs, M. Kovacs-Deak, L. Schaeffer, arXiv:2503.21090 (v2 Jul 2025; ACM TQC 2026)
prior_explicit.note: LP relaxation + numerical nonnegativity check; n = 7266 infeasible

asymptotic.statement: exact algorithms with (1/pi) ln n + o(log n) queries exist, matching the lower bound
asymptotic.source: J. Carolan, A. M. Childs, 'Optimal Quantum Algorithms for Ordered Search', arXiv:2609.34293 (28 Sep 2026; discovery credited to Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6-Sol)
asymptotic.note: analytic FGGS chain, parameters chosen for sufficiently large n; no explicit finite (k, n) instances; open: O(1) vs o(log n), explicit finite-n algorithms

certified_by_p09.note: exact certificate of Wu et al.'s numerical (6, 90000): 90000 <= N*(6) < 94000 (2026-10-31)
